subject: english
question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

The animals of a particular region
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e.** 'Fauna'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Fauna:** Fauna refers to the animal life or the collection of animal species present in a particular region or time period.(जीवजंतु जगत)
 
• It **includes** all the animals, both vertebrates and invertebrates
